walkthroughs.body_html:
Theory & Methods — a core area of GCSE Sociology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theory & Methods brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theory & Methods.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between reliability and validity in research?
options: Reliability is whether a method produces consistent results when repeated; validity is whether it actually measures what it claims to. A method can be reliable but invalid, or valid but unreliable.
Because crime makes society wealthier.
Reliable and valid mean the same thing — that the research is good.
